units: bytes and milliseconds; heap in bytes, forced GC, main page only
method: Three fresh contexts per CPU rate and paired EN desktop / AR mobile case. Synthetic loopback gzip/no-store. Main-thread TaskDuration and elapsed action/readiness include a 250ms settle interval. Worker CPU is not included in main-thread TaskDuration; page CPU throttling is not equivalent worker throttling or a four-core device equivalent. No total browser/process RAM measurement.

checks: bounded event/search reads and no workbook dependency on Inventory entry
Orders/Inventory filters and page size survive route visits without document reload
events arriving during a held read and cached-page return both show the newest data
badge displays the final count after events during a pending read
report first/last pages, filter reset, and zero-result behavior
real print sender preserves all 2,000 products and totals while screen is filtered
actual worker-generated template downloads and reopens with original values
pending import cannot submit; clear/replacement terminate workers and latest file wins
replacement confirmation and original uploaded File bytes preserved through a synthetic POST
legacy mapping and original upload bytes preserved through a synthetic POST
invalid workbook recovery, close-during-inspection cleanup, and stable RTL/session
